runner_pin.meaning: bytes/SHA256 of canonical sourcebundle manifest {schemaVersion:1,python_sources:{<filename>:{bytes,sha256}}}; NOT hash of runner.py alone or metadata JSON including its own hash.
runner_pin.canonical: Sorted keys, compact JSON, no NaN, UTF-8, no newline
runner_pin.versioning: DTO pin shape stays generic bounded bytes/lowercase SHA; do not hardcode this one observed bundle as the only version. Trusted server registration chooses approved verified bundle; persisted replay keeps its immutable registered pins.

separate_pins.output_validator: Independently pin output_contract.py bytes/SHA as well as its membership in complete bundle.
separate_pins.executable: Separately registered native_R executable pin. No host paths/environment/Owner/client matrices in DTO.

registration_preconditions: Server verifies all four exact source files bytes/SHA against trusted complete manifest before registration; verify manifest canonical bytes/SHA matches runner pin.
Server separately verifies output validator, scientific script and native executable pins and approved private process/filesystem configuration.
ExecutionRegistration value/model/metadata is neither approval nor Owner authorization. Authority verification and repository current Owner/RLS/source checks remain required.
No process_policy field added to8-key execution; policy source is covered by runner complete-bundle pin.
